plans.idea: Two-column split: the bottle stands as a tall left column while the logo and a big headline share a right column on one left edge, with the badge row (Build Your Mix plus flavours) spanning the full width underneath and legal as a footer.
Centered vertical stack faithful to the original: small logo on top, the bottle centered, a wide two-line headline, a full-width badge band, then legal, all on one central axis.

Headline first: a strong top-left block with logo and headline facing the bottle on the top right, and a tall full-width badge zone below where the chips and the Build Your Mix button can sit in two rows before the legal footer.
